label: maps to symbolic concept
summary: WikidataRoot defines light as a structured public entity. BibleRoot uses light as a symbolic and theological concept. These are not identical meanings, but they are connected views of the same term.

label: relates to
summary: Light relates to knowledge through the metaphor of illumination: making something visible, knowable, or understandable.

label: relates to
summary: Light relates to evidence because visibility and observation are often required before something can be inspected or confirmed.

label: relates to
summary: Light relates to truth through the symbolic idea of revealing what is hidden or making reality visible.
